transcript.speaker: Rohit (Demo Bank)
transcript.text: Namaste, Demo Bank customer care, main Rohit bol raha hoon. Main aapki kaise help kar sakta hoon?

transcript.speaker: Priya
transcript.text: Hi Rohit. 10 October ko maine apne landlord ko ₹4,500 UPI kiye the. Paisa mere account se kat gaya, but unke account mein nahi aaya.

transcript.speaker: Rohit (Demo Bank)
transcript.text: Ek minute ma'am, main check karta hoon. Haan, transaction pending dikha raha hai, UTR 628412937105.

transcript.speaker: Priya
transcript.text: Teen din ho gaye hain. Mujhe rent ki late fee lag rahi hai.

transcript.speaker: Rohit (Demo Bank)
transcript.text: Sorry ma'am. Maine complaint raise kar di hai, complaint number SR4471902.

transcript.speaker: Rohit (Demo Bank)
transcript.text: Aapka paisa 24 ghante mein reverse ho jayega.

transcript.speaker: Rohit (Demo Bank)
transcript.text: Toh hamari team aapko 48 ghante mein callback karegi.

transcript.speaker: Priya
transcript.text: Theek hai. Kya mujhe koi compensation milega?

transcript.speaker: Rohit (Demo Bank)
transcript.text: Ma'am, uske liye aapko branch visit karni padegi.

promises.quote: Aapka paisa 24 ghante mein reverse ho jayega.
promises.meaning: Your money will be reversed within 24 hours.
promises.quoteHi: आपका पैसा 24 घंटे में रिवर्स हो जाएगा।

promises.quote: Toh hamari team aapko 48 ghante mein callback karegi.
promises.meaning: If it isn't, our team will call you back within 48 hours.

rule.name: RBI Turn Around Time for failed transactions
rule.row: UPI: account debited but the beneficiary account is not credited (transfer of funds)
rule.suoMoto: Wherever financial compensation is involved, the same shall be effected to the customer's account suo moto, without waiting for a complaint or claim from the customer.

conflict.quote: Ma'am, uske liye aapko branch visit karni padegi.
conflict.meaning: For that you'll have to visit a branch.
conflict.why: The RBI circular says compensation must be credited suo moto, without a complaint or claim. A branch visit is not required.

escalation.note: The RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021 accepts a complaint once the bank has rejected a written complaint or not replied within 30 days.
